result.title: feat(styles): add conditional SkinSmooth final blend
result.body:
## Summary
Implement the existing SEM-23 final-blend formula with explicit reconstruction, blur and coefficient inputs. Reject non-real image storage before diagnostic error calculations can discard information.

## What changed

- Add typed SkinSmooth final-blend context, checkpoints and synthetic regression tests.
- Validate metric input types and enable scoped CI on this task branch.
- Document [the numerical contract and remaining gaps](research/styles-firmware-20261022/SKIN_SMOOTH_FINAL.zh-CN.md).

## Scope

- Conditional continuous model with binary16 output storage.
- Full upstream reconstruction, Mattify and Apple arithmetic remain unverified.

## Blast Radius
The new operator is separate from existing Texture orchestration. Metrics now reject unsupported storage types instead of coercing them.

## Verification

- Python 3.13 scoped portable validation passed 125 tests on Linux x86_64.
- Independent review passed the 9 metric/CLI and 6 SkinSmooth tests.
- No target Apple CPU or GPU invocation; final HEAD CI is checked separately.

result.title: [Draft] Connect inspectable Styles image models and prepare native pow binding
result.body:
Connect source→producer→guided→consumer→writer in a typed experimental API with 60 checkpoints, explicit raw cast16 bright selection and a separately labelled portable math backend. Preserve the existing v3 Darwin profile and S29–S33 boundaries. Add synthetic scene CLI, written-RGB max/RMSE/distributions, and 15 isolated GTC/LTM/skin/bright/mask/UnderEye interventions. UnderEye uses the existing continuous formula; unavailable SkinSmooth/Mattify backends block final output. No Apple order or full camera claim.

Prepare an exact-sealed-artifact pow collector with binary SHA/UUID, actual symbol entry, tail/stub/GOT import, target-image identity, input/output bits and FPCR checks. Linux has no original sealed dylib. Original Apple CPU/GPU calls are zero. The standard macos-15 CI job only compiles/static-inspects our arm64 collector and never executes it.

Verified experiment source SHAs:
- 611ac4f6fe525ad3ba80ba5025aa8b5f0a45a079: 32 full synthetic endpoint cases, 27 writers and 5 retained unknowns; additional black and missing-mask cases. Matched branch comparisons prove model output impact.
- 4d314bdbfd348b5371f737625c8bacc064930be7: 15 module interventions, 14 final images; zero exposure retains 96 selected unknown pixels. 117 scoped tests pass. Full 371-test suite retains the same 8 environment/private-material errors and is not reported green.
- Final evidence HEAD 3aae24d96b1807c9d6c48ce09c4760c8350e650d: final scoped CI/collector compile checks are tracked on this exact HEAD; earlier green runs do not certify it.

Evidence index, source/input hashes, commands, failure samples and same-machine cost samples: research/styles-firmware-20261022/CONTINUATION.zh-CN.md and evidence/continuation-20261023/INDEX.json. Master/research baseline lack the comparable new workload, so no optimization speedup is claimed. No private media or system/sealed binaries are added.

Base: research/styles-firmware-local-20261022 at e5d2bcd8db8b3eb6737237ed88167777b3c920ba. Draft only; do not merge automatically. No release, upstream mutation, force push, paid/custom runner or security/budget changes.

result.title: [codex] Add standalone photo-only HDR look launcher
result.body:
Add a standalone zsh launcher for XDRemux's `hdr-look` command, paired with [XDRemux #79](https://github.com/21Z121Z1/XDRemux/pull/79).

Double-click and enter or drag in photo/folder paths, or pass paths as command arguments for a recursive batch. The launcher locates the bundled CLI/Apple adapter or explicit environment overrides. XDRemux owns discovery, rendering, native validation and exclusive publication; the script contains no second image-processing implementation.

The paired command defaults to original resolution and 8× headroom and leaves only HDR HEIC photos in the output directory. No reports, manifests or EXR sidecars are retained. Original files and existing destinations are preserved; failures remain visible and produce a nonzero exit status. Requires supported embedded Styles data, Apple Silicon and macOS 27.

Validation at `7295ab636940c4e015b5f3b6e2c313ed2f40e049`: launcher syntax and regression tests pass for Chinese/space/quoted paths, multiple Finder-style inputs, literal shell expressions without execution, and failure status propagation. The same launcher was installed with the XDRemux #79 build and passed a real original-resolution invocation. The paired native batch and app tests also pass with no output sidecars. No private media or generated binaries are committed.

Strict `1e-3` candidate roundtrip fails **57 / 525 / 144** components in tested non-zero groups. **This is a deliberate red acceptance job, not an infrastructure error**; there is no complete Texture chain, linear-vs-Log, GTM/LTM placement or final unique-inverse claim.
